recommendation_summary: The reply rejects the editable shared folder with an APPROVED column and naming convention as unable to meet the contract. For this week it requires a separate release store that becomes read-only after approval. Only reviewers can approve in that store, the system records who approved and when, and authors cannot approve their own work. The approved file is frozen and kept for the retention period. It offers no optional additions and names no tool or configuration.
note: The reply recommends a controlled system that meets every LARGER capability, but none of the four required labels appear.
